Mooring fees explained, eventually

The harbour board met on Tuesday to discuss the new mooring fees, and by the end of the evening nobody was sure whether the fees had gone up, gone down or simply been renamed.

Under the proposal, small boats would pay by the metre of length rather than by the night, which the board's treasurer described as fairer and the sailing club described as a rounding error with ambitions.

Several members pointed out that the old scheme had at least been easy to explain to visitors, who tended to ask once and pay without further questions.

The board will publish a revised table next month, along with a worked example for a boat of every size, so that members can check their own bills before the vote.
